promptHead: Athlete goal: marathon (Wexley Lakes Marathon) on Sun Nov 1 2026, 10 weeks out, target under 3:45.

new.headline: Skip Wednesday's tempo and have the right knee examined this week: the pain grew over three runs and now shows on stairs. Running next week is short, flat and easy, and only if the knee stays quiet.

flags.title: Long run cut short
flags.detail: Planned 13 mi, you ran 8.5 and walked the last half mile when the outside of the right knee turned sharp on downhills. Stopping was the right call.

flags.title: Knee pain is building

flags.title: Race timeline

answers.question: Is this an IT band thing? Should I still do Wednesday's tempo?
answers.answer:
**Is this an IT band thing?** I can't tell, and I won't guess. Pain on the outside of the knee that builds on downhills and now shows on stairs has several possible causes, and only someone who examines the knee can sort them out. Book a physio or sports medicine doctor this week. Tell them it first tightened on a hill at the end of an easy run on Thu Aug 13, then turned sharp from mile 7 of Sunday's long run.

**Should you still do Wednesday's tempo?** No. Faster running loads the leg harder, and the knee was already hurting on easy-effort runs. Wednesday becomes 30 minutes of walking or easy biking, and tempo work waits until you have been seen and easy runs are pain-free.

new.analysis:
The only part of the week that went off plan was the long run, and the knee is the reason. The Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday runs matched the planned distances, and Wednesday's threshold work came out at the planned 4 mi at 8:00 pace. The long run was planned at 13 mi and ended at 9 mi, with the last half mile walked.

The knee pattern matters more than any single number. Pain went from nothing on Tue Aug 11 to 2/10 on the last hill Thursday, a tight 1/10 before Saturday's run, then 4/10 and sharp on downhills from mile 7 on Sunday. Pain that grows across several runs and follows you to the stairs the next day is a signal to stop testing it. Your pace slipped from about 9:55 to 10:45 over the last miles, so you were already protecting the leg before you stopped.

Next week is built to find out whether the knee is quiet, not to build fitness. Each run depends on the one before it going cleanly. If a run is dropped, it is replaced with walking or biking and not made up later, because cramming missed miles into later days is how a small problem becomes a long one.

Ten weeks is enough time to absorb a lighter week or two. Four steady weeks of training do not disappear in that time, while a forced layoff of a month would cost far more. If the professional finds something that needs longer, we revisit the under 3:45 goal then, with real information.

Bring a few facts to the appointment. Your mileage climbed from 30 to 32 to 35 mi over three weeks before this one, your long run went from 10 to 12 mi, and you have had no injuries in two years. Mention also that stairs only started bothering you after Sunday.

Once the knee allows, long runs need to come down in effort. Your easy share was 76%, just under the 80% target, mostly because long runs sat at 146 to 149 bpm, which put about half of that time in zone 3. When long runs return, hold them under about 145 bpm.

settingsProposalBullets: Right outside-of-knee pain began around Thu Aug 13 and was worst (4/10) on the Sun Aug 16 long run; you are getting it assessed.
Hold tempo and long-run work until a professional has seen the knee and easy runs are pain-free.
Easy runs stay flat and under about 145 bpm until the knee settles.

safetyCallouts.title: Get the right knee examined this week.
safetyCallouts.body: The pain has risen from 2/10 to 4/10 over three runs and now shows on stairs, which is new for you. I can't say what it is, so book a physio or sports medicine doctor and do no hard running until you have been seen.

safetyCallouts.title: Stop and get seen sooner if it changes.
safetyCallouts.body: Swelling, the knee giving way or catching, pain at rest or at night, or a limp when you walk are reasons to stop running and get it checked within a day or two.
